purpose: Real-site checks for the P1 items in ROADMAP.md. Batch L is the audit's first live batch (real-site-test-set.md, in its order), the 'first 12 real-site URLs' of the P1 exit. Batch 1 holds P1 defect checks written before that list was committed: practice sites first, where any failure is a W2L bug, and the blocking site last. Batch api covers the P1 items that are API behaviour rather than page content. Batch E checks the Evidence Record ('ER', ROADMAP 'Throughout P1') against its published schema on each lane's output. Each check names the P1 item it accepts ('FS' = no false success in general), or the audit's feature id (feature-matrix.csv) where no P1 item fits; each batch L case names its main feature.
rules: Cases and URLs are not replaced or dropped after freezing; a site that changes or disappears stays in the record with its result.
A check encodes the correct result, not the current one. A case passes when every check passes.
S10 and L06 need direct network access to wikipedia.org. On a network that only reaches it through an HTTP proxy, W2L cannot reach it today (no proxy support), and the record says so.
Batch L values that a site updates on a schedule (statistics releases, data updates, report years) are checked by pattern or minimum; the case note gives the values seen on 2026-09-29.
